description: Official Browser Use MCP server from the open-source browser-use package. Exposes browser navigation, clicking, typing, tab management, content extraction and screenshots over stdio, plus a tool that runs a full browser-use agent task. Started with `browser-use --mcp` from the `browser-use[cli]` extra.
author: Browser Use

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: LLM API key used by the browser-use agent tool. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY also works as an alternative.

name: Browser Use MCP
